codes.meaning: A relay in the control system is stuck shorted or the heating-element circuit/relay drive has failed.
The oven's door-lock motor ran a full minute without the control sensing the door had locked or unlocked, usually during self-clean.
The range either lost power briefly or the oven cavity got hotter than appropriate for the selected mode.
The main board has stopped receiving signals from the oven's control module.
The internal meat-probe circuit is reading as shorted, which can simply mean the probe isn't fully seated.
On induction range models, the main control isn't hearing back from the induction generator over its internal communication line.
A fuse tied to the power module's configuration settings has failed on this electric cooktop.
The cooktop's internal electronics got hotter than 158°F while running, tripping an overheat shutdown.
The touch control keypad itself is reporting a fault.
The induction generator module that drives the cooking coil has failed outright.
Liquid or a pan sitting on the glass surface over the control area is being misread as a control error.
The cooling fan inside the unit is malfunctioning.
